Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your blue Digimon or Tamers may unsuspend.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Veedramon] in its name suspends, if you have a blue Tamer, this Digimon may unsuspend.
